biggest_catch: You pay your own driving costs — a $7 Vue more than a few miles away can cost more in gas and wear than it pays.
catches: Driving costs (gas, wear) come out of your pocket; only nearby Vues make sense.
Optional background check unlocks higher-paying Vues; reviewers report it costs $9.99 (reimbursed if approved) — a small upfront cost to weigh.
Must maintain 85%+ rating for Preferred Vuer perks; low ratings limit access.
Availability is heavily location-dependent; small towns may have few Vues.

steps: Download the iVueit app and register free
Browse Vues near you showing payout per inspection
Claim a Vue and read the instructions
Travel to the site, take the requested photos, complete the survey, submit
Withdraw anytime — funds reach PayPal within 24 hours
timing: Wallet credited on Vue approval; withdraw anytime to PayPal, funds transferred within 24 hours. No minimum threshold.

repeatable.cadence: Claim Vues near you, finish the photo inspection, and withdraw from your wallet whenever you like — new Vues show up in the app as customers post them.

maximize: Guard your rating above 85% — that is the gate to Preferred Vuer status and the best-paying Vues. Only claim Vues near you; gas eats the $7 jobs alive. There is no payout minimum, so withdraw whenever you want.
who_pays: iVueit credits your in-app wallet for every approved Vue, and you withdraw those funds to your own PayPal account.
who_qualifies: 18+, US-based, with a smartphone (iOS or Android), the iVueit app, and location services turned on. You travel to inspection sites, so a car with a valid license and insurance is effectively required. Passing an optional background check unlocks higher-paying Vues.
work_available: Vues appear near you based on your location — the app notifies you when one is available, day or night, and you claim it in the app. Availability is heavily location-dependent; small towns may have very few Vues. Shoppers with an 80%+ rating get Preferred Vuer status (early access, claim up to 6 at once); 90%+ with 25+ completed Vues and a background check unlocks the Elite tier.
what_gets_accepted: Your wallet is credited only when the Vue is approved: travel to the site address, take the requested photos, complete the in-app survey, and submit. Your rating matters — keep it at 80% or higher to hold Preferred Vuer status and keep early access to the best-paying Vues.
costs_and_unpaid_time: No joining fee. Your driving costs are yours — gas and car wear come out of your pocket, so only claim Vues close by or a $7 job can cost you more than it pays. The optional background check is reported to cost $9.99 (reimbursed if approved). Unpaid time: claiming Vues, driving to sites, and submitting inspections.
when_cash_arrives: Your wallet is credited as soon as each Vue is approved, and you can withdraw to PayPal at any time with no minimum — funds arrive within 24 hours.
